missionEvents.title: Military session bound
missionEvents.description: Root session joined the fixed military preset and recorded its generation.

missionEvents.title: Military session quarantined
missionEvents.description: A resumed or changed session cannot safely execute under the active generation.

missionEvents.title: Preset generation resume checked
missionEvents.description: Resume adapter compared the persisted generation with the active or archived mount.

missionEvents.title: Preset migration completed

missionEvents.title: Mission started
missionEvents.description: A General opened one authoritative mission.

missionEvents.title: Mission command accepted

missionEvents.title: Mission intent ratified
missionEvents.description: The user-owned mission intent was ratified by General.

missionEvents.title: Direction ratified
missionEvents.description: General ratified a staff direction plan.

missionEvents.title: Wave opened
missionEvents.description: A schedulable wave entered execution.

missionEvents.title: Wave barrier satisfied
missionEvents.description: All required task, integration, specs and oversight conditions passed.

missionEvents.title: Task created
missionEvents.description: A versioned task order was added to the mission DAG.

missionEvents.title: Task leased
missionEvents.description: A role-bound agent received an exclusive task lease.

missionEvents.title: Task candidate submitted
missionEvents.description: A worker proposed a candidate for external verification.

missionEvents.title: Task blocker submitted
missionEvents.description: A worker submitted evidence of an unresolved blocker.

missionEvents.title: Verification completed

missionEvents.title: Task accepted

missionEvents.title: Task cancelled

missionEvents.title: Task rework requested
missionEvents.description: Harness issued a new task version after rejected verification.

missionEvents.title: Task integration queued
missionEvents.description: An accepted candidate patch entered the controlled main integration queue.

missionEvents.title: Task integrated

missionEvents.title: Integration regression failed

missionEvents.title: Radio request admitted
missionEvents.description: Evidence gate admitted a tactical guidance request.

missionEvents.title: Radio guidance issued

missionEvents.title: Radio guidance delivered

missionEvents.title: Decision question set created

missionEvents.title: Decision answered
missionEvents.description: Harness durably recorded the user response and provenance.

missionEvents.title: Decision question became stale
missionEvents.description: A pending user decision no longer matched the current mission or task revision.

missionEvents.title: Decision expired
missionEvents.description: An unanswered or stale decision set reached a terminal state.

missionEvents.title: Agent frozen

missionEvents.title: Agent released

missionEvents.title: Specs commit recorded
missionEvents.description: Engineer committed validated specs changes on controlled local main.

missionEvents.title: Compaction required
missionEvents.description: Context pressure crossed a template or General policy threshold.

missionEvents.title: Compaction attempted

missionEvents.title: Compaction completed
missionEvents.description: A compaction attempt ended with an explicit success, no-op or failure.

missionEvents.title: General model selection changed

missionEvents.description: A requested General session model failed a capability, reasoning, residency or budget gate and the previous route remained active.

missionEvents.title: Model fallback applied
missionEvents.description: An explicitly allowed compatible fallback replaced an unavailable route.

missionEvents.title: Resource budget reserved
missionEvents.description: Harness reserved bounded capacity before starting an expensive operation.

missionEvents.title: Resource budget settled
missionEvents.description: Actual usage was deduplicated against one reservation and unused capacity was released.

missionEvents.title: Resource budget threshold reached
missionEvents.description: A deployment, tenant, mission, wave or task budget reached policy threshold.

missionEvents.title: Resource budget exhausted
missionEvents.description: A hard limit stopped new admission and selected an explicit safe disposition.

missionEvents.title: Trajectory memory created

missionEvents.title: Effectiveness assessment scheduled

missionEvents.title: Effectiveness assessment created
missionEvents.description: Harness accepted a verified tactical effectiveness assessment.

missionEvents.title: Tactic version published
missionEvents.description: Governance published a new version into a controlled lifecycle stage.

missionEvents.title: Agent template instantiated
missionEvents.description: Runtime froze a template revision and effective model route for a child.

missionEvents.title: Agent execution binding created
missionEvents.description: Harness froze one non-General agent template, model, reasoning, policy and preset generation before publication.

missionEvents.title: Brainstorm completed

missionEvents.title: Chief of Staff advice issued
missionEvents.description: Chief generated a model-derived reference opinion with explicit assumptions.
